lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Hi, this is Grace with Willowbrook Financial, how can I help today?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Hi... sorry, I'm a little scattered, my husband passed away last month and I'm trying to sort out his accounts and I don't really understand any of these forms.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. While I have you, this is actually a great time to enroll in our premium advisory package, it's just $40 a month.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Oh, um, okay, I guess so.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Great, I'll get that set up for you right now.
